label: Doppelrahm
note: In Switzerland, Crème double de la Gruyère is a cream of about 45 % fat, listed in the Culinary Heritage of Switzerland

about.text: Switzerland’s double cream, at least 45 % fat, thick enough to spoon; the double crème of the Gruyère is eaten with meringues.

how.text: Doppelrahm is cream standardised to at least 45 % fat, so much fat that it is spooned rather than whipped. Traditionally the cream rises on whole milk left standing after milking, being the lightest part; the Fribourg Gruyère-region double cream is made this way from Gruyère-region milk.
